svg.title: Sa Calobra detail planning: observation stations, not rock footprints

g.text: AI proposals · 6 locations · 669 paired stations / 185 disconnected windows · Street View excluded

a.title: Roadside wall: readable planes and contact: road observation; physical surface location unresolved
Dominant massif above a separate close bank: road observation; physical surface location unresolved
Close rock and broad slope need different scales: road observation; physical surface location unresolved
Dominant peak: protect faces as well as skyline: road observation; physical surface location unresolved
Near bank and distant slope: preserve transitions: road observation; physical surface location unresolved
Sea-facing ridge and foreground banks are separate: road observation; physical surface location unresolved

g.text: A — Close contact: planes, edges, ledges,
road-ground contact; fine grain by material.
B — Dominant wall: outline, broad faces,
C — Panorama: skyline and large divisions;
fine interior detail unsupported in this view.
Not evidence for low priority or hidden D.

a.text: SC-P02: Upper-left massif B + separate close bank A
SC-P03: Close bank A + broad slope B
SC-P04: Peak B + separate reverse wall A
SC-P05: Near bank A; distant slope unresolved
SC-P06: Sea ridge C + separate foreground banks A

g.text: Points mark road observations, not rocks.
A/B/C badges apply to visible candidate regions.
Strokes show anchor viewing direction only.
No world footprints or whole-hill assignments.
Gaps stay disconnected. No performance measurements or geometry/material changes.
